name: Scratchpad Studio
author: Scratchpad Studio contributors
description: A studio for multiple scratchpads: named, hideable window sets that slide in on a keybind. See every scratchpad with a live schematic of its windows, create new ones from installed apps, pick layouts and slide-in anchors, bind chords with conflict checking, and toggle them all from the bar. Engine is native Hyprland special workspaces — no daemon.

barWidget.description: Manage and toggle named scratchpads. Left-click opens the studio; right-click opens it as a resizable window.

schema.label: Demo mode
schema.description: Show fake scratchpads and windows with made-up names. For screenshots and trying the UI; never shows real window titles.
